cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When Mum cancelled our birthday dinner, were you disappointed? Please answer about yourself first; I don't want us guessing at each other.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's another question, not an answer. Take your time. What did you do after she called?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I cried in the supermarket while I was putting the candles back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So did I. I told the cashier it was hay fever. Don't write that off as silly, please; I still haven't managed to return the cake.

reason: Use careful interview correction to keep B first, then allow B's concrete admission to cause A's own; replace the incoherent candles-as-allergies phrase.
